title: Power imbalances in fiduciary relationships and how to address them as an aspiring psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我自己的专属支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南-梅森礼品，以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, let's be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，让我来做你的向导吧。

sentences.en: And you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你将走上由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持的《有志心理学家》播客节目。

sentences.en: Hey, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嘿，欢迎收听《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, and I hope that you will find this really useful.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，希望你能觉得这非常有用。

sentences.en: Thank you for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Today is a special request from Haneen, who got in contact.
sentences.zh: 今天是一个特别的请求，来自与我取得联系的哈宁。

sentences.en: And she says, I'm thinking about what might be beneficial for aspiring psychologists could be power imbalances during our sessions and how to address these.
sentences.zh: 她说，我一直在思考对有志心理学家可能有益的一个问题，那就是我们咨询过程中的权力失衡以及如何解决这些问题。

sentences.en: And also maybe how we take into account social factors and inequalities when working with clients and families.
sentences.zh: 还有可能是在与客户和家庭合作时，我们如何考虑到社会因素和不平等现象。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for your request, I will do my very best to answer that for you, because it is a great question.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的请求，我会尽我所能为你解答，因为这是一个极好的问题。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: So when I was applying for doctorate places myself, I had a tendency to reflect on fiduciary relationships,
sentences.zh: 所以当我自己在申请博士学位名额时，我倾向于反思信托关系，

sentences.en: which might not be a relationship that you have heard of before.
sentences.zh: 这可能不是你以前听说过的一种关系。

sentences.en: But a fiduciary relationship is one where someone else has, you know, a duty of care for the other person.
sentences.zh: 但信托关系是指某人对另一个人负有某种关怀义务的关系。

sentences.en: So one person is coming along because they need something or maybe not always because they need something.
sentences.zh: 所以一个人来找你是因为他们需要什么，或者有时可能并不总是因为他们需要什么。

sentences.en: They might not think that they need anything, but one of you has a duty of care or some kind of responsibility for the other person.
sentences.zh: 他们可能认为自己不需要任何东西，但你们其中一方对另一个人负有关怀义务或某种责任。

sentences.en: So we would get fiduciary relationships if we were a psychologist and we had a client.
sentences.zh: 如果我们是心理学家而我们有一个客户，我们就会建立信托关系。

sentences.en: We'd get them if you were a GP, you'd get them if you were a dentist, you know, or an occupational therapist, you know, speech and language therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你是全科医生，你会有这种关系；如果你是牙医，你会有这种关系；或者是职业治疗师，言语和语言治疗师。

sentences.en: All of these professions would be, whether they knew it or not, because it's not a very common term, would be subject to fiduciary relationships.
sentences.zh: 所有这些职业，无论他们是否知道，因为这不是一个很常见的术语，都将受到信托关系的约束。

sentences.en: And there are obviously, you know, there's caveats to that that can make relationships a bit more complicated.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，这其中也有一些附带条件，会让关系变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: And, you know, so along the lines of the boundary setting episode, which I believe from the top of my head is episode eight, there are limits to our relationship.
sentences.zh: 沿着设定边界那一集的主题——如果我没记错的话，大约是第八集——我们的关系是有限制的。

sentences.en: And of course, our relationships should be friendly with our service users.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们与服务对象的关系应该是友好的。

sentences.en: They should be, you know, personable, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我相信，它们应该是平易近人的。

sentences.en: Although I have, you know, previously worked in a service where an hour is dynamic, and so that is a slightly different type of relationship.
sentences.zh: 尽管我过去曾在一种服务机构工作过，那里的动态关系有所不同，所以那是一种略有不同的关系。

sentences.en: You're still polite, you know, you're not rude to people.
sentences.zh: 你依然很有礼貌，对吧，你不会对人粗鲁。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's worth thinking about those power imbalances, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，思考这些权力失衡是很有意义的，你知道的。

sentences.en: I know that many clients I've worked with have wanted to call me Dr. Trent.
sentences.zh: 我知道我合作过的许多客户都想叫我特伦特博士。

sentences.en: And I say to them, you know, you don't have to call me Dr. Trent, you can just call me Marianne.
sentences.zh: 我对他们说，你知道的，你不必叫我特伦特博士，你只管叫我玛丽安就行。

sentences.en: But for them, perhaps culturally, or because it's just the way they've been brought up, they want to continue to call me Dr. Trent.
sentences.zh: 但对他们来说，也许是出于文化原因，或者因为他们从小受到的教育就是这样，他们希望继续叫我特伦特博士。

sentences.en: And I respect that about them, you know.
sentences.zh: 我尊重他们的这一点。

sentences.en: I'm not going to correct them every time.
sentences.zh: 我不会每次都纠正他们。

sentences.en: I will explain that with them, you know, once.
sentences.zh: 我只会向他们解释一次。

sentences.en: But many of them do still want to call me Dr. Trent, and clients that I might have been working with, you know, for over a year still message me in emails formally as Dr. Trent.
sentences.zh: 但他们中的许多人仍然想叫我特伦特博士，那些我可能已经合作了一年多的客户在电子邮件中依然正式地称我为特伦特博士。

sentences.en: But obviously, to my face, might call me Marianne.
sentences.zh: 但显然，当面可能会叫我玛丽安。

sentences.en: But, you know, we're not correcting or dismissing what a client brings to them.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们不会纠正或否定客户带来的东西。

sentences.en: But, you know, we do have to be very careful with how we are handling our power and our responsibility.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们确实必须非常小心我们如何处理我们的权力和责任。

sentences.en: And, you know, just to go over some of the boundaries stuff again, we have to make sure that we are being clear about the caveats to our role.
sentences.zh: 再次回顾一些关于边界的事情，我们必须确保我们明确说明我们角色的限制条件。

sentences.en: We need to make sure that people have insight and can make an informed consent, knowing what, you know, what therapy and dealing with us as a service entails for them.
sentences.zh: 我们需要确保人们有洞察力并能够做出知情同意，清楚地知道治疗以及与我们作为服务机构打交道对他们意味着什么。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you can't ever really talk too long about consent and about the limits of confidentiality.
sentences.zh: 所以，关于同意和保密限制的话题，怎么强调都不为过。

sentences.en: And, you know, sometimes it can be useful to say, you know, this applies for all of our sessions together.
sentences.zh: 有时，说一句“这适用于我们在一起的所有咨询”会很有用。

sentences.en: But sometimes people start at the beginning of every session by saying, you know, a little something about confidentiality again.
sentences.zh: 但有时人们会在每次咨询开始时说一些关于保密的小事情。

sentences.en: But, yeah, we do need to be mindful of the impact that we have over others, you know, and it's my clients seem to have a great deal of impact over what I watch on Netflix,
sentences.zh: 不过，我们需要注意我们对他人产生的影响，我的客户似乎对我在网飞上看什么有很大的影响，

sentences.en: because they will often tell me what they're watching.
sentences.zh: 因为他们经常告诉我他们在看什么。

sentences.en: And then I think, oh, well, I feel like I don't want to miss out on the party.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，哦，好吧，我觉得我不想错过这个热潮。

sentences.en: I feel like I need to get involved with that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我需要参与进去。

sentences.en: And, you know, I might have had a similar similar impact on you when I spoke about This Is Us.
sentences.zh: 当我谈到《我们这一天》时，我对你也可能产生过类似的影响。

sentences.en: You know, maybe recently you listen to that and you're like, well, I've never watched This Is Us, but she says that's all right.
sentences.zh: 也许最近你听了那期节目，心里想，好吧，我从来没看过《她说这没关系》。

sentences.en: You know, because you become a bit of an influencer, don't you, when you're chatting about things.
sentences.zh: 因为当你聊到某些事情时，你不知不觉就成了一个有影响力的人，不是吗？

sentences.en: So, yeah, we can have shared experiences with our clients, but we also have to know that there are differences.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们可以与客户有共同的经历，但我们也必须明白彼此之间存在差异。

sentences.en: And this is really useful fodder for supervision as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是督导中非常宝贵的素材。

sentences.en: And, you know, whilst you might have shared characteristics with your clients,
sentences.zh: 虽然你可能与客户有共同的特征，

sentences.en: we have to be careful that we're not over identifying or diminishing our clients' experiences because we have some understanding of what they've been through.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须小心，不要过度认同或贬低客户的经历，仅仅因为我们对他们所经历的事情有一定的了解。

sentences.en: But, you know, sometimes our clients will purposefully seek us out, especially in private practice,
sentences.zh: 但有时我们的客户会有意寻找我们，尤其是在私人诊所里，

sentences.en: because they believe that we will know and resonate with what they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 因为他们相信我们会理解并对他们谈论的事情产生共鸣。

sentences.en: Let's take a short break here and I will be back with you on the other side of this break.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里休息一下，休息回来后我会在另一端与你见面。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Mark.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫马克。

sentences.en: I'm an assistant psychologist in a specialist autism team in Liverpool.
sentences.zh: 我是利物浦专业自闭症团队的一名助理心理学家。

sentences.en: And I've just gotten on to the doctorate in Exeter starting this September.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚被埃克塞特大学的博士项目录取，将于今年九月入学。

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist podcast has been great for me.
sentences.zh: 《有志心理学家》播客对我非常棒。

sentences.en: The content and the guests are brilliant.
sentences.zh: 内容和嘉宾都非常精彩。

sentences.en: And I think Marianne does a really good job as a host of being really positive, normalising negative experiences and reminding people to be compassionate towards themselves.
sentences.zh: 我认为玛丽安作为主持人做得非常好，她总是积极乐观，将负面经历正常化，并提醒人们对自己保持同情。

sentences.en: For me, the podcast is especially useful because I feel like I'm always busy.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，这个播客特别有用，因为我总觉得自己很忙。

sentences.en: And on the run up to interviews, I could listen to it whilst I was at the gym.
sentences.zh: 在面试前的准备阶段，我可以在去健身房时听它。

sentences.en: And it allowed me to feel as though I was still getting that important time for myself and do things that are important for me whilst still engaging with stuff that is going to help me on my psychology journey without needing to carve out any separate and dedicated time for it.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得我仍然在为自己留出重要的时间，做对我重要的事，同时还能接触到能帮助我实现心理学梦想的内容，而不需要为此专门腾出独立的时间。

sentences.en: I definitely recommend that anyone wanting to know more about working in psychology,
sentences.zh: 我绝对向任何想更多了解心理学工作的人推荐，

sentences.en: give this podcast a listen as it gives a really clear and honest insight into the things you can expect.
sentences.zh: 去听听这个播客，因为它对你可能遇到的情况提供了非常清晰和诚实的见解。

sentences.en: Okay, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 好的，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: So I was talking to a journalist yesterday about eating alone and cooking alone for ourselves and how that can be an ultimate act of self-care.
sentences.zh: 昨天我和一位记者谈论了独自一人吃饭、独自为自己做饭，以及这如何能成为关爱自我的终极行为。

sentences.en: But I also asked her to make reference to the fact that for many people currently,
sentences.zh: 但我也请她提及这样一个事实：对于目前许多人来说，

sentences.en: it would feel like a bit of a decadent thing to do to be perhaps switching an oven on just for ourselves or, you know,
sentences.zh: 仅仅为了自己一个人打开烤箱，或者，

sentences.en: using all the resources of using a gas hob and then having to wash up all of the stuff just for one person.
sentences.zh: 使用燃气灶的所有资源，然后还得为了仅仅一个人清洗所有的东西，会让人觉得是一件相当奢侈的事情。

sentences.en: And I think unless you've got some awareness of the social context of that, unless you've, yeah, just taken that on board, then we need to be make,
sentences.zh: 我想，除非你对其中的社会背景有所了解，除非你真正理解了这一点，否则我们需要确保，

sentences.en: we need to make sure that some of the suggestions and some of the things we might be discussing with clients, you know, for activity scheduling, for example,
sentences.zh: 我们需要确保我们与客户讨论的一些建议和事情，例如活动安排，

sentences.en: or for building structure and routine into life to make it more functional and enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 或者为了让生活更有功能性和乐趣而建立结构和常规，

sentences.en: We do need to make sure that we're not, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们需要确保我们没有，

sentences.en: socially unaware of what it is like for our service users to be trying to navigate the world at the moment when they might well be, you know, scared of, you know,
sentences.zh: 对我们的服务对象在当前这样一个他们可能害怕某些与大流行相关的因素的时期在世上艰难前行时的感受缺乏社会意识。

sentences.en: factors associated with the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 与大流行相关的因素。

sentences.en: They might, you know, they might, you know, be struggling financially to heat homes or put food on the table.
sentences.zh: 他们可能在经济上挣扎着给家里取暖或维持温饱。

sentences.en: And so it is really useful to have conversations with people, even when it might look like they couldn't possibly be struggling for money.
sentences.zh: 因此，与人们进行对话非常有用，即使看起来他们绝不可能缺钱。

sentences.en: It's useful to check in with people about, you know, some of the factors from the Maslow's hierarchy, just to check how things are for them financially.
sentences.zh: 向人们了解马斯洛需求层次理论中的一些因素，以检查他们目前的经济状况，这是很有用的。

sentences.en: How things, you know, you're not asking for bank statements here, but if someone is really struggling to pay their water bill or, you know, they're worried that they can't,
sentences.zh: 你并不是在这里索要银行对账单，但如果有人真的在努力支付水费，或者他们担心自己负担不起，

sentences.en: you know, can't cover the cost of the next food shop.
sentences.zh: 负担不起下一次购买杂货的费用。

sentences.en: That really does impact on people in, in a big and important way.
sentences.zh: 那确实会对人们产生巨大而重要的影响。

sentences.en: And I had a recent conversation with a client where it came, came to light that they, they weren't really sure how they were going to fill their cupboards next time.
sentences.zh: 我最近与一位客户进行了交谈，其中暴露出他们确实不知道下一次该如何填满自己的橱柜。

sentences.en: And so we used a bit of our time in the session to look at options for, you know, emergency food provision.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在咨询中利用了一点时间来寻找紧急食品供应的选项。

sentences.en: And that then freed the client up to, to feel validated, to feel seen.
sentences.zh: 这随后让客户感到被认可、被看见，从而得到了解放。

sentences.en: And it wasn't done in a way at all to be shaming, but to just feel like they had other options available to them.
sentences.zh: 这样做绝对不是为了让人感到羞耻，而是让他们觉得自已还有其他可选的方案。

sentences.en: Because if you feel like you can't feed yourself or your children, then it's, you don't know where your next meal is coming from.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你觉得自己无法养活自己或孩子，那么你就不知道下一顿饭在哪里。

sentences.en: It's very difficult to think about anything else, you know, because it can really dominate things.
sentences.zh: 你很难去想别的事情，因为它真的会主导一切。

sentences.en: So it's important for us to have conversations, even though it might be very different to your own experiences currently.
sentences.zh: 因此，对我们来说，进行对话很重要，尽管这可能与你目前自己的经历截然不同。

sentences.en: So I know everybody is feeling the pinch of increased cost of living, but where, where people, where clients have got limited resources,
sentences.zh: 我知道每个人都在感受到生活成本上升的压力，但当人们、客户的资源有限时，

sentences.en: because the benefits haven't been increased, then, you know, the pressures are going to be that much more really
sentences.zh: 由于福利没有增加，那么压力就会大得多，

sentences.en: than if you're working with a client who is able to put up their wages or put up their rates or, you know, go out there and earn more money
sentences.zh: 比起那些能够提高工资、提高收费标准，或者仅仅通过接纳更多客户就能赚到更多钱的客户来说，

sentences.en: just by picking up some more clients, for example.
sentences.zh: 比如通过接纳更多客户。

sentences.en: So just having an awareness of the social factors that are around right now can be really useful.
sentences.zh: 因此，只要对当前周围的社会因素有所了解，就会非常有用。

sentences.en: And similarly, you know, when I've worked with clients who are in social housing, it's very difficult to imagine if you aren't in that context yourself
sentences.zh: 同样地，当我与住在社会保障住房里的客户合作时，如果你自己没有身处那种环境，就很难想象，

sentences.en: about just what an impact it has upon you if you are living in close proximity to, you know, a crack den, for example,
sentences.zh: 如果你住在比如毒品窝点附近，会对你产生多么大的影响，

sentences.en: which is something that one of my clients had experienced and the impact that has on you of being able to smell crack all the time
sentences.zh: 这是我的一位客户曾经经历过的事情，闻到冰毒的味道所带来的影响，

sentences.en: and feeling like it's in your home and, you know, it's affecting your health.
sentences.zh: 并且觉得它就在你的家里，正在影响你的健康。

sentences.en: And so, you know, sometimes even just having a conversation about your home, what it's like, how you feel to be there when you're there.
sentences.zh: 所以，有时甚至只是简单地谈论你的家，它是什么样的，你在那里时感觉如何。

sentences.en: Does it feel like a place of sanctuary or are there factors that make it very tricky?
sentences.zh: 它感觉像一个避难所，还是存在一些让人非常头疼的因素？

sentences.en: So they might not tell you about some of these factors just unless you ask, because there may be a great deal of shame or stigma.
sentences.zh: 因此，除非你主动询问，否则他们可能不会告诉你其中一些因素，因为可能存在大量的羞耻感或污名化。

sentences.en: And similarly, I work with someone else who's got, I don't work with them anymore,
sentences.zh: 同样地，我曾与另一个人合作过，我不再与他们合作了，

sentences.en: and their neighbor's dogs were incredibly noisy and it was, you know, affecting all areas of their well-being, really.
sentences.zh: 他们的邻居的狗吵闹得不可开交，这确实影响了他们福祉的方方面面。

sentences.en: And it was incredibly difficult, but it wasn't something that I never, I necessarily would have thought to ask about
sentences.zh: 这极其困难，但这不是我必然会想到去询问的事情，

sentences.en: had we not been doing a bit of a rundown of, you know, of what it's like to be them, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果我们没有对他们的生活状态进行一番梳理的话，

sentences.en: take me through your day from morning to night and, you know, give me a flavor of some of the things that crop up for you in that day.
sentences.zh: 从早到晚带我走一遍你的一天，让我感受一下你在那天中遇到的一些事情。

sentences.en: So that can be a really useful exercise, getting to know your client and getting to know the unique struggles,
sentences.zh: 这可以是一个非常有用的练习，去了解你的客户并了解他们独一无二的挣扎，

sentences.en: which they might not necessarily be thinking are contributing to their difficulties.
sentences.zh: 而他们未必认为这些挣扎正在导致他们的困境。

sentences.en: But as we know, they really can.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们所知，它们确实会。

sentences.en: You know, if it's impacting on our sleep or it's impacting on our ability to nourish or provide for ourselves or our children, then that can be very difficult indeed.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果它影响了我们的睡眠，或者影响了我们养活自己或孩子的能力，那么这确实会非常困难。

sentences.en: And neighbor conflict is a big deal, you know, because it can really make people feel, you know, vulnerable in their home.
sentences.zh: 邻里冲突是一件大事，因为这真的会让人在自己的家里感到脆弱。

sentences.en: So these are important conversations to have.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是必须要进行的有意义的对话。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think being brave enough to ask questions, but also just saying, well, how is that for you?
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为要有勇气去提问，同时也要说：这对你来说怎么样？

sentences.en: What's that like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Or being honest, you know, I don't have any experience of of growing up in a situation where, you know, English wasn't my first language, for example.
sentences.zh: 或者坦诚地说，我没有任何在英语不是我的第一语言的环境中长大的经验。

sentences.en: How how has that been for you?
sentences.zh: 那对你来说是怎么样的？

sentences.en: And I was recently doing a session with someone who spoke three or four languages.
sentences.zh: 我最近在和一位会说三四种语言的人进行咨询。

sentences.en: And so I asked them, well, how is it when I ask you questions in English and that isn't your first language?
sentences.zh: 所以我问他们，当我用英语向你提问而英语不是你的第一语言时，感觉如何？

sentences.en: Can you tell me what goes on for you at that time?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我当时你心里在想什么吗？

sentences.en: And they were then able to answer, you know, what that is like for them.
sentences.zh: 然后他们能够回答那对他们来说是什么样的。

sentences.en: And they said that under pressure, it does get it does get a bit trickier.
sentences.zh: 他们说在压力之下，事情确实会变得有点棘手。

sentences.en: But generally speaking, they are able mostly to think about situations now in English.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，现在他们大部分时间都能用英语思考各种情况。

sentences.en: But under pressure, we will often revert back to our earliest coping strategies.
sentences.zh: 但在压力之下，我们往往会退回到最早的应对策略。

sentences.en: It might be worth knowing that for many of our clients that we might be working with, their earliest coping strategies might not almost be, you know, within the British.
sentences.zh: 值得了解的是，对于我们合作的许多客户来说，他们最早的应对策略可能并不完全在英国文化的范围内。

sentences.en: If you're listening to this in Britain, they might not be socially that common within our British culture.
sentences.zh: 如果你在英国收听这个节目，它们在我们的英国文化中可能没有那么常见。

sentences.en: So it's worth thinking with our clients about about what makes them unique and about their coping strategies
sentences.zh: 因此，值得与我们的客户一起思考是什么让他们变得独一无二，思考他们的应对策略，

sentences.en: and their way of thinking about the world and what things have been like growing up and how that might be different for them now.
sentences.zh: 以及他们看待世界的方式、成长过程中的经历，以及现在对他们来说有何不同。

sentences.en: So many of my clients in the past have have have then been not with their family, you know, not in the same birth, not in the same country as their birth families.
sentences.zh: 因此，我过去的许多客户都曾与家人分离，不在出生家庭所在的国家。

sentences.en: And that has its own unique challenges as well.
sentences.zh: 这也有其独一无二的挑战。

sentences.en: So, yeah, just be open and interested and compassionate and wise.
sentences.zh: 所以，保持开放、好奇、富有同情心和智慧。

sentences.en: And don't be afraid to ask how things are for your clients.
sentences.zh: 不要害怕询问客户目前的状况如何。

sentences.en: Don't always assume that, you know, you know, we really want to be getting a bespoke feel for for your clients as being unique and valuable people
sentences.zh: 不要总是想当然地认为，我们真的希望为你的客户提供量身定制的感受，把他们当作独特而有价值的人，

sentences.en: and not just being treated as a number.
sentences.zh: 而不仅仅是把他们当作一个数字来对待。

sentences.en: So that's my own personal take on it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我个人的看法。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I hope you found this useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: Heneen, I hope this was what you imagined it might be.
sentences.zh: 哈宁，希望这正是你所想象的那样。

sentences.en: But if it hasn't been, let me know and I can give it another go.
sentences.zh: 但如果不是，请告诉我，我可以再试一次。

sentences.en: OK, thank you so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢您的收听。

sentences.en: Please do take a moment to rate and review my podcast episodes on the Apple podcast app.
sentences.zh: 请花一点时间在苹果播客应用上为我的播客节目评分和写评论。

sentences.en: Find me, the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 搜索我，也就是“有志心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: Scroll right to the bottom, right underneath the trailer.
sentences.zh: 一直滚动到最底部，就在预告片的下方。

sentences.en: And that's where you'll find the rate and review section.
sentences.zh: 这就是你找到评分和评论板块的地方。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们的收听。

sentences.en: If you would like to sign up to the waiting list for the Aspiring Psychologist membership, you can do that by checking out the details in the show notes or on my link tree.
sentences.zh: 如果你想注册加入“有志心理学家”会员资格的候补名单，可以通过查看节目简介或我的链接树中的详细信息来完成。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening and hope you have a lovely day.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听，祝你拥有美好的一天。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取超越“出售时间换取金钱”模式的收入会怎么样？

sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来我一直在开发被动和循环收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些好消息要宣布。

sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了这个项目，此后也一直陪伴两期心理学家走过了他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖品以及我专属的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森的美食礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
